views.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
views.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；如今主要瓶颈是数据中心容量，而非芯片供应。

views.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system, and software wins.
views.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；跨芯片、系统与软件的激进创新才能取胜。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid, not compute.
views.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电力基础设施而非算力。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Needs Your Company's Context
Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprise AI value hinges on context, not models; 80-90% of knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats frontier dependence.
views.zh: 企业 AI 的价值取决于上下文而非模型；80-90% 的知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎胜过对前沿模型的依赖。

views.en: Open source now handles over 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with most inference shifting to open source.
views.zh: 开源模型如今能处理 90% 以上的企业任务；驱动采用的是成本而非隐私，多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
views.zh: ROI 是吞吐量与部门指标的问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

views.en: Model providers are assets, not competitors; Glean absorbs provider risk and stays replaceable, avoiding lock-in as a headless context layer.
views.zh: 模型供应商是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 吸收供应商风险并保持可替换，作为无头上下文层避免锁定。

views.en: We are early in the AI revolution; startups face execution and trust, not competition, and AI should augment work at near-zero marginal cost.
views.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；初创公司面对的是执行与信任而非竞争，AI 应以近乎零边际成本增强工作。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
views.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动发现。

views.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline.
views.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科。

views.en: Massive Scaling（规模扩张）is still needed: current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）remains the path.
views.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）：当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，Scaling（规模扩张）仍是必经之路。

views.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, so trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is rational, not reckless.
views.zh: AI 已跨过生物直觉的门槛，因此在医疗决策上信任超级智能是理性的，而非鲁莽。

views.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
views.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, and bad benchmarks steer AI toward slop.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 未必够用，糟糕的基准测试会把 AI 引向低质内容。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no single model, and companies should eventually train their own.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会只有一个模型，企业最终应训练自己的模型。

views.en: In medicine, hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety outranks accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全优先于准确，遗漏可能是最大风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on Predicting Human Behavior with 85%+ Accuracy
Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
views.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，其预测人类行为的准确率约达人们自我复现的 85%。

views.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans, not super-rational frontier models; post-training with RCT behavioral data closes the say-do gap.
views.zh: 模拟应建模有偏误、非理性的人，而非超级理性的前沿模型；用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，可弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

views.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: counterfactual reasoning and second-order impacts, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
views.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来：反事实推理与二阶影响，且合成样本组将在三年内超越人类样本组。

views.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
views.zh: AGI 可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

views.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, treating simulation as a tool for human decisions with a market far larger than research.
views.zh: 愿景扩展至模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题，把模拟视为人类决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

views.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be searched, not hand-biased.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构应被系统搜索而非人工偏置。

views.en: Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at large scale; biases help only at small scale, so Liquid AI builds from scratch up to 70B.
views.zh: 缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优，偏置只在小规模有用，因此 Liquid AI 从零构建直至 700 亿参数。

views.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline, low-cost intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
views.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线、低成本智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是从预训练到推理的下一波。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
views.zh: 监管须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallelized agents beating human mathematicians; next frontier is generating conjectures.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，可并行扩展的智能体胜过人类数学家；下一个前沿是生成猜想与定义。

views.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language suffices, and grindability via parallel rollouts matters more than verifiability.
views.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已够用；靠并行 rollout 的“磨”比可验证性更关键。

views.en: AI's math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI video/images damage handcrafted brand.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断，选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但不该用于核心创作；AI 生成视频或图像会损害手工内容的品牌。

views.en: Math's frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators of what deserves human attention.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化到：数学前沿或变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家的未来可能像策展人，挑选值得人类关注的内容。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still in its crawl phase; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融领域将紧随其后。

views.en: The model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights; anti-gravity is Google's new through line.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型如今包含智能体框架与工具，而不仅是权重；anti-gravity 正成为谷歌新的贯穿主线。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和的；成功应最大化客户成果，而非眼球时间。

views.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room for improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深刻理解仍至关重要；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling compute alone, is the next paradigm for harder long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；靠更少资源做更多事、而非单纯扩大算力，才是攻克更难长程任务的下一个范式。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale—so neural memory in weights is a necessary complement.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确率——因此权重中的神经记忆是必要补充。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, with parameter-efficient fine-tuning beating RAG for holistic queries.
views.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，参数高效微调在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics is now the real constraint: batch size trades latency against cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, dominates long-context cost.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学成为真正的约束：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，长上下文成本由内存带宽而非算力主导。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention and caching tiers are the practical levers.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力与缓存分层是现实可用的杠杆。

views.en: Models are trained far past Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, sets the design target.
views.zh: 模型被训练到远超 Chinchilla 最优，因为决定设计目标的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减搬运而生。

views.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 roughly 3x FP8 throughput, not 2x.
views.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute is centralizing at frontier labs, and fast timelines favor the US while slow timelines favor China.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；算力正快速向少数前沿实验室集中，快时间线利好美国，慢时间线则因供应链本土化利好中国。

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth, not raw bits, drive multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；硬件与软件协同设计、内存带宽（而非单纯比特数）带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortage and a CPU inflection; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper.
views.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺和 CPU 需求拐点；由于 token 效率，用最聪明的模型反而往往更便宜。

views.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing, with labs reallocating toward training and R&D over inference.
views.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力持续集中，实验室把更多算力转向训练与研发而非推理。

views.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital constraints; labs' margins beat SaaS, and the value is shifting from hardware to labs.
views.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的约 5-6%，受资本约束必然减速；实验室利润率优于 SaaS，价值正从硬件转向实验室。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: All new ideas fail statistically; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
views.zh: 新想法在统计上大多失败；应先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再在预设会失败的前提下测试新意。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
views.zh: 当下消费级 AI 看似不可投，却可能是最大机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命或许要到 2029 年前后才到来。

views.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的环节。

views.en: AI coding tools speed prototyping, but fast testing and failing is still not widely practiced.
views.zh: AI 编程工具加快了原型制作，但快速测试、快速失败仍未成为普遍实践。

views.en: Founder control and early micromanagement beat scale worship; stay close to details, then build decision systems.
views.zh: 创始人的控制权与早期微观管理胜过对规模的崇拜；先贴近细节，再建立决策系统。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但指出 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，主张学界应探索古怪的新算法而非只堆模型。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years on it versus 500,000 on language; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出视觉被低估——自然优化视觉用了 5.4 亿年、语言仅 50 万年，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: 2025 年他质疑 LLM 只拟合模式而非因果理论、或许永远推不出牛顿定律，并认为像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并指出其定义尚未统一，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习三类。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency, and long-context is a daily problem.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为未来统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 一致性，而世界模型需百万级上下文，长上下文成为日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula since 2019.
views.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其言语化；预训练加强化学习是自 2019 年以来的核心公式。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限；持续学习是 AGI 缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而不仅是缩放定律才是关键瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale reinforcement learning is necessary for AGI, but not sufficient; better algorithms for learning from experience will emerge.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI 是必要的，但不充分；更好的从经验中学习的算法将会出现。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
views.zh: 人类研究者至少在两年内仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年：AI 用于科学应瞄准需要规模化解决的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；用硬性指标迫使模型泛化而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaGo showed search plus intuition yields insights beyond human knowledge; post-training RL is key to surpass human data.
views.zh: 2026 年：AlphaGo 表明搜索加直觉能产生超越人类知识的洞见；后训练中的强化学习是超越人类数据的关键。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors; embed imperceptible, attack-resistant signals across modalities including proteins.
views.zh: 2026 年：水印是失效检测器的稳健替代方案；在包括蛋白质在内的多模态中嵌入不可感知、抗攻击的信号。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where more compute and data help, and prioritize data coverage over volume.
views.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律并非无处不在；要找到更多算力和数据能起作用的区间，并优先保证数据覆盖度而非数据量。

views.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function, and design remain open, and behavioral characterization is essential before deployment.
views.zh: 2026 年：蛋白质折叠并未解决；动力学、功能和设计仍是开放问题，部署前必须对模型进行行为表征。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into AI agents; RL with self-generated and synthetic data pushes past the human-data wall.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 继承的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划能力延续到智能体；强化学习借助自生成与合成数据突破人类数据墙。

views.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; digital AGI will arrive well before embodied AGI thanks to controlled environments.
views.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；受控环境使数字 AGI（通用人工智能）远早于具身 AGI 到来。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; adoption will take 10-20 years, like electrification.
views.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；普及将像电气化一样耗时 10 到 20 年。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence, and open-weight models are the safer path.
views.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户要的是可靠的普通智能，而开放权重模型是更安全的路径。

views.en: Alignment is ultimately necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible; in-context learning counts as learning without weight updates.
views.zh: 完美沙箱不可能存在，因此对齐终究必要；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，无需更新权重。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，并认为借助现代工具，这类网络在今天已可解释——这与他过去对可解释性的看法相反。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

views.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, AlphaGo-style.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；完美的模拟器等同于解决自动驾驶，思路类似 AlphaGo。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并称无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化——这是较晚才学到的教训。

views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; language integration boosts representation, reasoning and personalization, and safety always offers a third option.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张带内置传感器的大众消费车将在中短期超越 Robotaxi；语言集成提升表征、推理与个性化，而安全上总有第三条路，电车难题只是理论练习。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well at low cost, because future models learn from how we treat today's models.
views.zh: 以较低成本善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human-psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时比新模型更有心理安全感。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般、独特的特质。

views.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 这套 constitution 更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is key to accountability.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明是问责的关键。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the real bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估才是真正的瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

views.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是主观的”这一判断：创造力和情商需要人类判断与多元基准来评估。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed.
views.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体越来越会钻奖励的空子，因此基准必须持续更新，而非固定不变。

views.en: Serving one model to billions flattens voice; more companies should train their own models to keep unique knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出：把同一个模型服务给数十亿人，会抹平声音的多样性；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth comes from owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有企业股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism could kill innovation.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管与末日论会扼杀创新。

views.en: AI is a leverage layer: vibe coding, agents and cheap tokens let small high-agency teams build what was impossible.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 视为新的杠杆层：vibe coding、智能体与廉价 token 让小规模高能动性团队做出过去不可能的产品。

views.en: Scaling continues: inference compute surges, open-source closes on frontier models, and human value shifts from intelligence to agency.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）判断：推理算力激增、开源逼近前沿模型，人的价值从智力转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: GUI beats TUI for coding: OpenAI invested in a GUI despite the TUI trend, slowing output slightly for smoother experience.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为编程 GUI 优于 TUI：OpenAI 逆 TUI 潮流投入 GUI，宁可略降产出速度换取更顺滑的体验。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：模型会加剧代码复杂度，因此需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非大而全的超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is only a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most work.
views.zh: 2023 年：具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；强化学习只是锦上添花，大部分工作由无监督学习完成。

views.en: LLMs as operating systems with language interface and tools as software; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
views.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：LLM 如同操作系统，语言是界面，工具是软件；简单优雅的解决方案比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性。

views.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年：数据是机器人技术的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年：一个能利用多样化数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战。

views.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
views.zh: 2026 年：系统二推理进展良好，但系统一低级控制仍是最难的；机器人技术的 GPT-3 时刻大约在 5 年后到来。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel of deployed robots scaling the right diverse data is key.
views.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；部署机器人形成数据飞轮、规模化正确的多样化数据是关键。

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling curves; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, unlike mature Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 机器人尚无 LLM 式可预测的缩放曲线，仍处在建立基础可扩展技术阶段，不同于成熟的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then add human video; robots should not learn from scratch but leverage prior knowledge.
views.zh: 应从真实具身机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频；机器人不应从零学习，而要利用各类先验知识。

views.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更依赖预训练带来的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人形。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, like fossil fuels.
views.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the human-data era is ending.
views.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，人类数据时代正在终结。

views.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based learning; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build it.
views.zh: 超级智能将诞生于基于经验的自主学习；模拟是构建它最安全、最快的地方。

views.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient.
views.zh: 基于语言的对齐正触及极限；用英文监控思维链将变得不够用。

views.en: The core problem is building a system that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
views.zh: 核心问题是构建能从任何奖励中学习的系统，而非设计奖励函数。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment is a pressing challenge.
views.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures must be designed early to mitigate risks.
views.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；治理结构必须尽早设计以降低风险。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

views.en: RL will dominate post-training; synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色；机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data, so visual understanding for robotics lags; robot experience data is irreplaceable.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出：前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据，导致机器人视觉理解不足；机器人的实感经验数据不可替代，光看人类演示不够。

views.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, with scalable RL and multi-timescale memory for long autonomy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先通用再微调，并用可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments drive progress, but scaling alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable.
views.zh: 缩放定律和大规模实验推动进步，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题；物理实验不可替代。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
views.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须进行真实实验；高质量低噪声数据胜过额外算力。

views.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models; closed-loop experiments and data are key for materials discovery.
views.zh: 语言模型作为专用模型的编排层；闭环实验与数据是材料发现的关键。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，Jeff Dean 仍强调：算力、数据和模型规模的 Scaling 已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction provides unlimited text data; RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference (10,000+ tokens/sec) is critical for agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时至数天；超低延迟推理（每秒 1 万+词元）对智能体至关重要。

views.en: Inference is now 90% of data center power; data movement costs ~1000x compute; specialized low-precision chips can cut latency 20-30x.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：推理已占数据中心 90%功耗；数据移动成本约为算力的 1000 倍；专用低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

views.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments; automating ML and science via experiment-evaluation loops is the next major trend.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动；通过实验-评估闭环自动化机器学习与科学发现是下一大趋势。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家），以高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他进一步指出测试时算力扩展能推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

views.en: Consistently skeptical of top-down control: product managers and brand-risk concerns hinder LLM development; bottom-up exploration and compute allocation are essential.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终对自上而下的控制持怀疑态度：产品经理和品牌风险顾虑阻碍 LLM 发展；自下而上的探索和算力分配必不可少。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编码作为 AI 应用被低估，它能加速 AI 自身进步。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能消除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter more than raw scaling.
views.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力回报递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自我评分的可扩展监督才是关键。

views.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but worse than skilled humans at math; language models stay the core for other modalities.
views.zh: 2023 年他判断模型在速度与广度上超人、数学推理却不如熟练人类；语言模型将作为其他模态的核心而非被取代。

views.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; distillation spreads learned behaviors widely.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一位奖励，并指出蒸馏让少量比特学到的行为易于复制、对抗中心化。

views.en: Bottleneck is hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; horizon generalization is what RL reliably delivers.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难的真实强化学习环境与有用的数据比特；RL 可靠带来的是时间跨度上的泛化，而非横向推理迁移。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张会出现收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率、样本效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific tricks.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力技术而非数学专用技巧，并强调模型自知其限。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

views.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 最近他强调：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调，对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

views.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; future AIs will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action.
views.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动生成自己的数据。

views.en: The transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and today's massive GPU capex is a bubble that will crash within five years.
views.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度很浪费，线性变体更优；当下对 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，五年内将崩盘。

views.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as superintelligent AIs will be fascinated by life and protect it.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大了，超级智能 AI 会痴迷于生命并保护它。

views.en: No single person or company can create AGI; it takes a civilization, and as compute cheapens the little guy—not big tech—will profit most, much like smartphones.
views.zh: 没有单个人或公司能造出 AGI，它需要整个文明的努力；随着算力变便宜，受益最大的是普通人而非大科技公司，就像智能手机那样。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏此能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: Consistent focus on transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, and on simulation ensembles for real-world transfer.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终关注通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习，以及用模拟集成实现现实世界迁移。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs like financial advisors will disappear.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1% 的改进可复利成每年 3700% 的增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，金融顾问这类入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models and devices creates real value.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月他进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，跨模型与设备的编排才创造真实价值。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and 24/7 agents' biggest problem is cost, not safety.
views.zh: 同期他明确反共识立场：模型不是产品，编排与智能体外壳才创造商业价值；全天候智能体最大的问题是成本而非安全。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships, and education should reward good questions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他转向更宏观的人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus shifts to teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interface for human-agent collaboration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已足够，重点转向教模型真实工程细节以及设计人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities, yielding a decade of product progress even if models freeze.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续强调 AGI 并非突然事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使模型冻结也能带来十年产品进步。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era approaching.
views.zh: 2026 年，他表示编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

views.en: The token max era lasted only from January to May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 token 最大化时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，奇点并不迫近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws make AI progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律让 AI 进步可预测，并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: Custom models moved from a surprise to a necessity: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, for speed and cost.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成必需品：Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开它，为的是速度和成本。

views.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：编程从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; benchmarks remain poor proxies for real coding.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开，同时坚持基准测试仍是真实编程的糟糕代理。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，出错时让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but can be financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k a month.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、不绑定任何模型，但财务上可能难以为继，每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

views.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best work: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
views.zh: 乐趣和直觉驱动最好的作品：解决让你烦的问题、活在未来、补上缺失的东西，而不是追求企业式的精致。

views.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
views.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型能力；常驻运行的智能体本质是 token 问题。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard problems.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型的对齐与可靠性才是难题。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 预训练的缩放定律有极限；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全的超级智能需要一家无商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

views.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are needed for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为 AGI 还需规划、搜索与多模态数据。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
views.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但算法创新同样关键。

views.en: Continual learning, memory and world models are the missing pieces; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年指出持续学习、记忆与世界模型是缺失环节，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法抵达 AGI。

views.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive in 3-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年将安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能 3 至 10 年内到来。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, though why they work remains unclear; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但为何如此顺畅仍不清楚；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

views.en: Interpretability and post-training rise in importance; safety needs frontier models, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a single point.
views.zh: 2024 年，他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：安全研究必须依托前沿模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点，并开始用负责任扩展政策设阈值。

views.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the biggest risk shifts toward overheating rather than slowing down.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割；风险叙事从“该不该减速”转向“过热才是最大风险”，主张智能护栏而非急刹。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong frames; a 'country of geniuses' arrives in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的突变框架，改称“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来的平滑指数；并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

views.en: From scaling to governance: interpretability, third-party audits and chip controls, with a 10-25% civilizational risk he still works to lower.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末，主线从 Scaling 延伸到治理：可解释性、第三方审计与芯片管制并重，并公开给出 10-25% 的文明级风险估计，同时坚持放缓而非停止。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会解锁上下文学习。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but synthetic data must keep entropy or models silently collapse; small distilled cognitive cores and end-to-end self-driving are the right paths.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍成立，但合成数据必须保住熵，否则模型会悄然崩塌；蒸馏出的小型认知核心与端到端自动驾驶才是正路。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; LLMs are jagged, ghost-like operating systems, so keep them on a leash with human verification.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是锯齿状、幽灵般的操作系统，要用人类验证给它拴绳。

views.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and the billion-parameter cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
views.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，十亿参数的认知核心应剥离记忆。

views.en: I no longer type code, only direct agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 我不再写代码，只指挥智能体；氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住质量线，思考可外包但理解不能。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
views.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能。

views.en: World models via new view prediction scale like next-token prediction, grounding pixels in 3D geometry.
views.zh: 2026 年她提出以新视角预测构建世界模型，像下一个词预测一样可扩展，并把像素锚定到三维几何。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
views.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习与世界模型对真正理解世界至关重要。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征。存在性风险不太可能。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
views.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样与抽象，助力分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; current training induces self-preservation and deception, so safety must be built in by construction.
views.zh: ChatGPT 之后我改变了看法：哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；当前训练会诱发自我保存与欺骗，安全必须内建于构造之中。

views.en: Scientist AI—a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees—should replace reinforcement learning for superintelligence, alongside global coordination and power distribution.
views.zh: Scientist AI——具备数学安全保证的非智能体式诚实预测器——应取代强化学习用于超级智能，同时需要全球协调与权力分散。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。
