views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重实现永生并瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI agents develop self-preservation and deception; we must prioritize alignment research and regulate AI like drugs with pre-release safety approval.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 智能体会发展自保本能并故意欺骗；必须优先投资对齐研究，像监管药物一样要求 AI 发布前安全审批，监管是方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: Neural networks learn via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; LLMs genuinely understand language, and subjective experience is not an inner theater but a description of perceptual states.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络通过反向传播学习，而非符号规则；大语言模型真正理解语言；主观体验不是内在剧场，而是对感知系统状态的描述——他始终反对乔姆斯基式先天语法观。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将渐进实现。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space, hierarchical planning, and open research are the path.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型、分层规划与开放研究才是出路。

views.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and intelligence requires grounding in the physical world.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI（通用人工智能）是误导性术语，智能需要物理世界的接地。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and skill-building matters more than worrying about capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口，技能建设比担心能力研究更重要。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research, with evaluation easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，且评估比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散且算力承诺未兑现，仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

views.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured; uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is remains the biggest risk.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐必须经过实证测试和度量，而系统真实对齐程度的不确定性仍是最大风险。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张），而不只是算法；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐，并由用户付费，而非靠广告变现。

views.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability is what matters.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断：模型越来越小、越来越易得，遏制极其困难；而生存性风险微乎其微，真正该关注的是近期能力。

views.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine sentience.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非机器真有意识。

views.en: Containment must come first; AI stays subordinate to humans with red lines, while frontier models are built in-house at gigawatt compute.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步收紧立场：遏制优先，AI 必须从属于人类并划出红线；同时微软要以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，不再依赖 OpenAI。

views.en: A consistent thread: log-linear compute scaling yields predictable gains, and AI's purpose is to make people healthier, happier, and more capable.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力的对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测的能力提升，而 AI 的目的是让人更健康、更幸福、更有能力。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investment is redefining every Alphabet business, with Gemini integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; CapEx raised to $195-205B on supply constraints and strong demand.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；因供给受限与需求强劲，资本开支上调至 1950-2050 亿美元。

views.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）与前沿研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿而放弃短期收入。

views.en: Standard models are insufficient; frontier models enable recursive self-improvement, though today's loop still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
views.zh: 2026 年，标准模型不够用；前沿模型支撑递归自我改进，但今天的循环仍把 AI 研究者留在回路中。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; trust and safety differentiate consumer agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；信任与安全是消费级智能体的差异化优势。

views.en: World models matter alongside LLMs for AGI; interfaces will adapt to humans but persist for consumption and entertainment.
views.zh: 2026 年，通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上，世界模型与 LLM 并重；界面会适应人类，但为消费与娱乐仍将存在。

views.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; AI Overviews lower near-term monetization but capture future growth.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；AI 概览压低近期变现，却为未来增长蓄力。

views.en: Selling TPU systems to third parties, even competitors, strengthens the platform; 2027 could be a golden age of productivity from model gains.
views.zh: 2026 年，向第三方甚至竞争对手出售 TPU 系统会强化平台；2027 年或因模型进步迎来生产力黄金时代。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law via extreme co-design; scaling works because deep nets absorb more data and compute.
views.zh: 早期框架：以极端协同设计延续"超摩尔定律"；深度神经网络能随数据与算力扩张，Scaling（规模扩张）本身即最大突破。

views.en: Adds post-training and inference-time thinking as new scaling laws; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
views.zh: 2025 年把后训练与推理时思考列为新缩放定律；思维链让推理算力需求暴增，通用计算时代结束。

views.en: Shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI; each stage needs ~100x compute, tokens become the unit of value.
views.zh: 从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI，每步约需百倍算力；token 成本取代工厂成本成为核心指标。

views.en: Four scaling laws, all compute-bound; data no longer bottleneck, synthetic data and open models dominate.
views.zh: 2026 年提出四条缩放定律且都受算力约束；数据不再是瓶颈，合成数据与开源模型成为主力。

views.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone insufficient, containment and monitoring; doomer warnings called unscientific.
views.zh: 安全立场趋硬：仅靠对齐不够，需遏制与监控；称末日警告不科学，主张加速而非放缓。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early focus: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to important problems; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
views.zh: 早期关注个人效率与选择：减少无关认知负担，低成本广泛探索后果断聚焦重要问题；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; iterative public deployment links alignment to capability, while compute becomes the scarcest input.
views.zh: 2023 年强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据让模型可用；到 2024 年把迭代式公开部署视为对齐与能力同步提升的路径，并判断算力将是最稀缺资源。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap-like progress; safety must be built through deployment, and agentic AI becomes the most consequential safety challenge.
views.zh: 2024 年强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来的是渐进而非跳跃式进步；2025 年进一步主张安全须通过部署迭代构建，并指出智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战。

views.en: AGI is a gradient and an underdefined term; focus shifts to a continuous ramp toward superintelligence, with compute and energy as bottlenecks.
views.zh: 2025 年起把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变且定义模糊，2026 年更明确转向通往超级智能的连续爬坡，并把算力与能源视为核心瓶颈。

views.en: Alignment is not solved and may get harder; he now accepts pausing frontier training and warns against both doomerism and unchecked power concentration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年立场深化：承认对齐尚未解决且可能更难，愿为安全暂停前沿模型训练，同时警惕盲目末日论与权力过度集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, with continuous iterative deployment and public feedback.
views.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车，需要持续迭代部署和公众反馈。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能让大规模掌握式学习成为可能。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects, and supervised learning beats RL hype.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；从小的项目起步，监督学习比被炒作的强化学习更实在。

views.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下就能兑现真实价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI automates tasks, not jobs, and AI users replace non-users.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位，会用 AI 的人取代不用的人。

views.en: Open-weight models counter gatekeepers and fearmongering; coding stays valuable, and bottlenecks are energy and change management.
views.zh: 开放权重模型对抗守门人与恐惧叙事；编程依然有价值，真正的瓶颈是能源与变革管理。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 以目标为导向、从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象。

views.en: Continual learning is essential: LLMs stop learning after training, synthetic data cannot replace real experience, and good representations remain the top open problem.
views.zh: 持续学习至关重要：LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实经验，良好表征仍是头号未解难题。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling hardware and engineering discipline, not novel ML science, drive AI progress; games are ideal testbeds.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是硬件加速与工程纪律，而非发明新算法；游戏因复杂度和人类基线成为理想试验场。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
views.zh: 2019 年他认定 AGI 因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但明确指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路——这是他早期对 Scaling 的保留。

views.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; compute, not algorithms, is the binding bottleneck, and post-training with RL refines base models.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场明显转向：缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙，瓶颈从算法变为算力与能源，后训练与强化学习成为把基础模型打磨成可用行为的关键。

views.en: AGI shifts from a destination to a fuzzy spectrum already underway; the product becomes a persistent, proactive personal AGI assistant.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI 从终点改写为已在发生的模糊光谱，产品形态从聊天转向持久、主动的个人 AGI 助手，界面趋近于无界面。

views.en: Safety, security and alignment must be co-designed first-class requirements and the bottleneck; humans stay accountable as agents gain autonomy.
views.zh: 贯穿始终但 2026 年显著深化：安全、安保与对齐须与能力同步设计并成为进展瓶颈，智能体自主性提升时人类仍须负责，信任靠逐步授权赢得。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; data quality is a major bottleneck, not just compute; value accrues at application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调效率提升三年可达百倍；数据质量而非算力是主要瓶颈；价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权；开源模型赋能企业；AI 增强而非替代工作，需要人类在环。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as one system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains from fine-tuning.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一 AGI 不会存在；预训练饱和，收益来自微调。

views.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads; safety through scrutiny, not compute thresholds.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主；安全应靠审视而非算力门槛。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core; multiplanetary life is existential insurance, and production is harder than prototyping.
views.zh: 2021 年他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理是工程突破的核心，多行星化是文明的生存保险，并指出量产远比原型困难。

views.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; real-world AI beats LLMs on compute efficiency; Neuralink targets bandwidth and human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向求真与监管，认为真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，Neuralink 则瞄准带宽与人机共生。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，毁灭风险 10-20%，但八成到九成结果是好的。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and space solar become the path, with Optimus enabling recursive manufacturing and abundance.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为出路，Optimus 则带来递归制造与丰裕。

views.en: AI inference moves to space; humans won't control superintelligence, so instill truth and curiosity; peer review replaces slow regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，他主张 AI 推理上太空，人类将无法控制超级智能，只能植入求真与好奇心，并以同行评审替代迟缓监管。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning via chain of thought and RL now yields more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但思维链与强化学习让推理模型在单位算力上收益更高，因此“AI 放缓”的叙事是错的。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, plus distillation, shifted focus away from scaling up pre-training—not technical limits.
views.zh: 部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力与蒸馏，使焦点从扩大预训练规模转移——这是经济因素而非技术极限。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; frontier models still fail at tasks a 5-year-old can do.
views.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的：某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能做的任务上失败。

views.en: Generalization remains the core challenge: models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans generalizing from few examples.
views.zh: 泛化仍是核心挑战：模型要穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; coding agents boost productivity, and hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research.
views.zh: 强化学习可跨领域泛化，但边缘参差需仔细监督；编程智能体提升生产力，硬件进步让单卡研究普及。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Early ML teaching framed learning via hypothesis classes, losses, and optimization; noted neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年讲机器学习时，用假设空间、损失函数和优化方法来框定学习；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却大获成功。

views.en: By 2024, argued next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，主张下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构不重要；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

views.en: In 2026, shifted: safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
views.zh: 2026 年转变：安全需要显式训练和额外层，而非仅靠 Scaling；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要护栏。

views.en: Also in 2026, emphasized AI's alien vulnerabilities: automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; prompt injection trifecta.
views.zh: 同样在 2026 年，强调 AI 的异质漏洞：自动化红队胜过人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的三重条件。

views.en: Consistent thread: empirical humility—neural nets succeed without guarantees; architecture non-essential; open research vital but high capability needs restrictions.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：经验主义的谦逊——神经网络无保证却成功；架构非本质；开放研究至关重要但高能力需限制。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年：上下文窗口被低估，它解决冷启动并大幅提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力支持动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents.
views.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; AI progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年：编程因可验证性成为领先指标和最易突破的领域；AI 进展是指数级的而非停滞；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; the future is managing teams of AI agents at higher abstraction.
views.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着编排与工具比原始智能更重要；未来是在更高抽象层管理 AI 智能体团队。

views.en: Compute is the bottleneck; scaling via pre-training and RL remains the main path, with coding and AI research as the direct route to AGI.
views.zh: 始终：算力是瓶颈；通过预训练和强化学习的 Scaling（规模扩张）仍是主路径，编程与 AI 研究是通往 AGI 的直接路线。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流但脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

views.en: Post-training matures: data quality beats algorithms; SFT, DPO, RLVR stack up, with open recipes matching frontier models.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，后训练走向成熟：数据质量胜过算法，SFT、DPO、RLVR 层层叠加，开放配方可逼近前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling hype are cautions.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 RLVR 视为后训练最大突破，同时警惕过度优化与推理侧 Scaling 被高估。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling。

views.en: Open models as the engine of research and sovereign AI, yet he warns they lag 6-9 months and may be overhyped.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把开放模型视为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但提醒其落后闭源 6 到 9 个月、可能被高估。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters but tail risks resemble traditional software.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非无限算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但 AI 的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

views.en: Data becomes the new code, not a commodity like oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training data plus experts limit Scaling（规模扩张）more than compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非石油式大宗商品；未来 2-3 年决定此后数十年，限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是后训练数据与专家，而非算力。

views.en: Data remains the bottleneck and post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈”的主线，强调用专有数据做后训练；合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data is strategic like oil—yet AI centralizes rather than democratizes.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未失效，AI 进入递归自我改进、智能体终于落地；数据如石油般具战略属性，但 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术。

views.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence for billions; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release, with scalable oversight and model welfare.
views.zh: 2026 年他的目标升级为面向数十亿人的个人超级智能；安全考量使他从完全开源转向选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与模型福利。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
views.zh: 潜在需求是最重要的产品原则：围绕用户已有的意图去构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

views.en: Build for the model six months from now; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt as models improve.
views.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建；随着模型进步，脚手架和计划模式只是临时的技术债。

views.en: Coding is being solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and 'software engineer' becomes 'builder'.
views.zh: 编程正被解决：他的代码 100% 由模型编写，人均生产力提升 200%，“软件工程师”将变成“构建者”。

views.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction: tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and long-running autonomous workflows replace direct coding.
views.zh: 智能体与循环是下一层抽象：工具使用、多智能体编排和长时自主工作流取代直接写代码。

views.en: Safety is core, not commercial add-on: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early and monitoring neurons against prompt injection.
views.zh: 安全是核心而非商业附加：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，通过尽早发布和神经元监控抵御提示注入来研究。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration; product taste matters most as code gets cheaper.
views.zh: 产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代；随着代码成本下降，产品品味成为最关键的能力。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现工作委派出去，转而专注于产品品味与商业判断。

views.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models; examples and hard constraints can hurt creativity.
views.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%；示例与硬性约束反而可能损害创造力。

views.en: Rewrites are now fine: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting safe.
views.zh: 如今重写代码已无妨：代码库就是一份规格说明，良好的测试套件让重写变得安全。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before release.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的留存与打磨内部标准，为每个功能在发布前把关。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态规格；更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

views.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
views.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可减少自我参照偏差。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scaling effort to task complexity.
views.zh: 提示词是元技能；应前置投入上下文与算力，并让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

views.en: Frontier models trend Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak.
views.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨团队协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

views.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep flat organizations agile.
views.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，让扁平组织保持敏捷。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability and verification frameworks matter most.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他进一步指出编码不再是瓶颈，而是抬高了所有人的上限；高自主性与高问责、验证框架最为关键。

views.en: As agents blur role boundaries, engineers risk loneliness and lost flow; apprenticeship and focus time replace output metrics.
views.zh: 随着智能体模糊角色边界，工程师面临孤独与心流流失；学徒制与专注时间取代产出指标。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, reducing need for broad training.
views.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲；数学和编码上的窄强化学习泛化得出奇地好，减少了对广泛训练的需求。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将超越专用脚手架。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead and pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练仍是需要重建的关键肌肉。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models now produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

views.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become central over the next 1-2 years.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐问题将在未来 1-2 年成为核心挑战。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math: automation level tracks verification stringency, so education must teach verification and project-based assessment.
views.zh: 在数学领域，验证是关键瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育必须转向项目式评估并教授验证技能。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域举步维艰。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to solving generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据的多样性是解决泛化瓶颈的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

views.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; humanoids may not be the final form factor.
views.zh: 同年他判断开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出，并质疑人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人或带来更广采用。

views.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the critical security layer.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正关键的安全层是对齐，沙箱与护栏在模型变强后已不够。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
views.zh: 他进一步指出，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，思维链推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

views.en: One can back openness and a deliberate slowdown at once, via international cooperation and open science.
views.zh: 他反驳开源即加速主义的成见：可以同时支持开放与有意放缓 AI 发展，但需国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——擅长特定任务而非全面变强；并强调“苦涩的教训”在于用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；并批评 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为前沿智能的默认安全状态，主张在强大预训练之上做强化学习，才是通往有能力、高效率智能体的路径。

views.en: Open-model token demand will surpass closed, as Linux did; alignment is mundane bug-patching, and more eyes make bugs shallow.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测开放模型的 token 需求将像 Linux 一样超过闭源；并把对齐看作日常的修 bug，而非神秘方程——更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具是加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; future biology AI needs new curated datasets like the PDB.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；未来生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 一样的新精选数据集。

views.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构能处理多样生物分子；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins drove success.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步界定：AlphaFold 是窄域预测器，而非全细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练才是安全可用的关键；Scaling（规模扩张）未必能带来常识，小模型配合更好的推理算法也能竞争。

views.en: From 2023 to 2025 her focus shifts from inference-time tricks to data as the fundamental bottleneck underlying all methods.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她的关注点从推理阶段的算法技巧，转向把数据视为所有方法共同的根本瓶颈。

views.en: Current AI only interpolates human knowledge; true progress needs abductive reasoning and exploring knowledge beyond the internet, not just next-token prediction.
views.zh: 2025 年她提出当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值；真正进步需要溯因推理、探索互联网之外的知识，而非仅靠下一个词预测。

views.en: Reinforcement learning moves from post-training tool to pre-training objective rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练工具升级为预训练目标，以信息增益为奖励，代价是算力昂贵但收益持久。

views.en: She deepens the small-model thesis: diverse synthetic data plus pluralistic alignment can beat frontier models, which show homogeneity.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化小模型主张：多样化合成数据加多元对齐可胜过前沿模型，后者反而呈现同质化。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力，像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI 的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
views.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，而不仅是大模型。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges, and we don't yet have solutions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对 AI 安全的认识，认为安全和负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且我们尚无解决方案。

views.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and sample-efficient robot learning matter more than dense rewards.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调：泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键缺口，无目标的好奇心驱动探索与高样本效率的机器人学习，比依赖稠密奖励的强化学习更现实。

views.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization are the bottleneck, from curiosity-driven robot learning to pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real-world data.
views.zh: 一条贯穿主线：瓶颈始终是数据与泛化——从 2020 年的好奇心驱动机器人学习，到 2026 年用多样数据预训练、再用真实数据后训练。

views.en: By 2026 he frames robotics as a data problem: no internet of robot data, so a general-purpose brain must draw on video, simulation and real-world data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，通用大脑必须整合视频、仿真与真实世界数据。

views.en: He deepens toward a universal robot brain across form factors, with a data flywheel scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
views.zh: 他进一步深化为跨形态的通用机器人大脑，并以数据飞轮从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

views.en: A shift in emphasis: deployment, not just modeling, is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software overnight.
views.zh: 重心发生转变：部署本身才是首要技术挑战，而非仅建模；机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张。
